mLocKeys.keySummary:
Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise fires a cocoon, <status>Stunning</status> and revealing the first enemy hit for @StunDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Cocoon</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is wrapped in a web and is unable to move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Cocoon: Slow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by Elise's Cocoon.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Rappel</titleLeft><mainText>Elise is dangling on a web. She can descend upon nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Skittering Frenzy</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Spider Swarm</titleLeft><mainText>Elise's spell casts in Human Form ready Spiderlings. When she shifts into Spider Form, Spiderlings are summoned and attack nearby foes.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Spider Form</titleLeft><mainText>Elise is transformed into a menacing spider. She deals bonus Magic Damage on attack and has access to her arachnid abilities.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise fires a cocoon, <status>Stunning</status> and revealing the first enemy hit for @StunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise injects neurotoxin, dealing <magicDamage>@BaseDamage@ plus @HumanPercentHealth@ current Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules><keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor> and <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor> percent Health damage is capped at @MonsterDamageCapCalc@ against monsters.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals <magicDamage>@spell.EliseHumanW:TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription:
Spider QueenHuman: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling (max @f3@).

Spider: Basic attacks deal a bonus @f1@ (+@f2@) magic damage and restore @f4@ (+@f5@) health to Elise.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.

Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling (max @spell.EliseR:SpiderlingsStored@).

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage and restore @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalHealing@ Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor> Abilities and summons all dormant <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Transforms into Human Form, removing Spider Form bonuses but granting the ability to generate new Spiderlings by casting spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor>: Elise returns to <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor> and all remaining <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor> become dormant.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ascends into the air, briefly becoming untargetable, and then descends upon an enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings lift into the air, becoming Untargetable for up to 2 seconds and descending on enemies she targets. Upon descending, she increases the bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen by @spell.EliseSpiderE:PBonusIncrease*100@% for @spell.EliseSpiderE:BuffDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Spider Form:</keywordMajor> Elise lunges with a poisonous bite, dealing <magicDamage>@Spell.EliseSpiderQCast:BaseDamage@ plus @Spell.EliseSpiderQCast:MissingHPDamage@ missing Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Venomous Bite will apply on-hit effects once to the target</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Venomous Bite: Slow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by Elise's Venomous Bite.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Elise and her Spiderlings gain a burst of Attack Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Spider Form Passive: Spiderlings gain @spell.EliseSpiderW:PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Spider Form Active: Elise grants herself and her Spiderlings @spell.EliseSpiderW:ActiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @spell.EliseSpiderW:BuffDuration@ seconds.
